name: Synthetic closed-corpus no-answer stress set
base_group_rule: Development and final synthetic questions use source paragraphs from their respective frozen answerable benchmark split. No base paragraph crosses the split.
entity_rule: Each question introduces an explicitly constructed unique fictional referent with no aliases and no facts inserted into the fixed corpus. The question requests a property or relation of this referent, not an unrelated fact about the real source title.
absence_rule: Check the complete normalized fictional name in every raw paragraph and title of the fixed corpus. This confirms no accidental mention; construction provenance and the required subject relation establish the synthetic label. String absence alone never establishes a natural-question no-answer label.

dev.absent_entity_location: {title} 관련 기록을 기준으로, '{entity}'가 설립된 도시는 어디인가?
dev.fabricated_relation: {title}가 '{entity}'와 합병했다고 하는데, 그 합병 날짜는 언제인가?
dev.fictional_future_event: 2047년에 '{entity}'가 주최하는 '{event}'의 개최 장소는 어디인가? {title} 자료를 근거로 답해줘.

final.absent_entity_location: '{entity}'의 설립 장소를 알려줘. {title}에 관한 자료에서 해당 도시를 확인해줘.
final.absent_entity_identity: '{entity}'를 창립한 사람의 이름은 무엇인가? {title}와 관련된 근거를 제시해줘.
final.fabricated_relation: '{entity}'와 {title}가 공동으로 창립 기념식을 연 일자를 알려줘.
final.fictional_future_event: 2091년 '{entity}' 주최 '{event}' 행사가 열리는 도시는 어디인가? {title}에 관한 근거로 답해줘.

regression_rule: Preserve the six previously exposed debugging probes in a separate regression file. They are never final-holdout examples and do not increase the synthetic final denominator.
natural_false_premise_rule: A real-entity unsupported-premise case needs targeted source review and a traceable reason against the whole fixed corpus. Retain the fan-club dissolution probe only in regression with its review scope and source references, not as independent held-out evidence.
limitations: This is a constructed closed-corpus stress set, not an independently human-labeled natural-language unanswerability benchmark.
No-answer rates may be optimistic because synthetic names and explicit future years can be easy to reject.
Surface templates, complete entity names and base paragraphs are disjoint across development and final; broad linguistic patterns and source articles can still overlap.
The construction contains unsupported relations, not proof that every analogous real-world event is false.
The fixed corpus consists of public KorQuAD validation paragraphs and has no live information or private account access.
